order_batches_shape_ck.name: order_batches_shape_ck
order_batches_shape_ck.value:
(attribution_type <> 'INDIVIDUAL' OR attributed_participant_id IS NOT NULL OR collective_label IS NOT NULL)
        AND (attribution_type <> 'GROUP' OR collective_label IS NOT NULL)

corrections_reason_ck.name: corrections_reason_ck
corrections_reason_ck.value: reason IS NULL OR reason IN ('UNAVAILABLE')

participants_removed_ck.name: participants_removed_ck
participants_removed_ck.value: (removed_at IS NULL OR role = 'GUEST') AND (removed_reason IS NULL OR (removed_at IS NOT NULL AND char_length(removed_reason) <= 140))
